description: This PHP source file defines the class OX_Maintenance_Priority_Campaign, representing campaign placement entities in the Revive Adserver project. It includes properties for campaign details, delivery statistics, and methods for initialization, setting ads, and retrieving statistics.

classes.name: OX_Maintenance_Priority_Campaign
classes.description: Entity class representing campaign placements with properties for campaign data, delivery stats, and methods for initialization, ad management, and statistics updates.
